description: This file defines API routes for handling financial transactions such as deposit, withdrawal, and transfer within a banking backend system. It uses FastAPI framework components like APIRouter and incorporates database interactions with asyncpg. It also manages transaction records and account balance updates.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Data model representing a transaction record, including details like id, account_id, type, amount, description, related_account_id, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: _get_account_for_user(conn: asyncpg.Connection, account_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches account details for a given user and account ID from the database.

methods.name: Transaction deposit(payload: DepositRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles depositing funds into an account, recording the transaction, and updating the account balance.

methods.name: Transaction withdraw(payload: WithdrawRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles withdrawing funds from an account, ensuring sufficient funds, recording the transaction, and updating the account balance.

methods.name: Transaction transfer(payload: TransferRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Manages transferring funds between two accounts of the same user, ensuring atomic transactions and recording outgoing and incoming transaction records.

ctags.name: _get_account_for_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def _get_account_for_user(conn: asyncpg.Connection, account_id: int, user_id: int):$/

ctags.name: deposit
ctags.pattern: /^async def deposit(payload: DepositRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection), u/

ctags.name: transfer
ctags.pattern: /^async def transfer(payload: TransferRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection),/

ctags.name: withdraw
ctags.pattern: /^async def withdraw(payload: WithdrawRequest, conn: asyncpg.Connection = Depends(get_connection),/
